messages.author: 96b171d2e941ddba
messages.subject: How to get back the fits
parts:
If I use stat_smooth(method = "lm") in my factored ggplot2 graph, is
there a way to get the fits returned to me in numeric form so that I can
subtract them out from the data?

Thanks,
Jim Rome

(meant to post this to the entire list)
Hi Jim-

this kind of pulling stats out is not really officially sanctioned, but it can be done. in fact, using the ggplot_build() as I used before to check the calculated box plots. When I asked about doing this, Koshke mentioned that i can not rely on it to exist in the future... 

the only problem with this is that you'll have to do a smoothing spline or feed some other param to stat_smooth to get the value at every data point.


z<- rnorm( 1000)
f=data.frame( x=1:length(z), y=z)
g <- ggplot( f, aes( x=x, y=y) ) + stat_smooth(method='lm') + geom_point()
gb <- ggplot_build( g )
str(gb$data)
